newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary PM says 1998 inflation may go down to 9pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary PM says 1998 inflation may go down to 9pct.

text.p: Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn confirmed on Monday that the country may reduce inflation to single-digit figures in 1998.
"Following consultations with the Finance Ministry we see a chance for inflation to be between nine and 13 percent in 1998," Horn told a news conference.

Hungary's inflation target for 1997 is 17 to 19 percent compared with an actual 23.6 percent in 1996. The finance ministry recently said that Hungary may reduce inflation in 1998 by more than the previously planned five percentage points.
